title: No WAN Link
shortDescription: ASUS router WAN port shows no link.
fullDescription: WAN LED off means no physical link on the blue WAN port - check cable and modem.

fixSteps.title: Reseat WAN cable
fixSteps.instruction: Firmly seat ethernet in WAN port.

title: No Power
fullDescription: Power LED completely off means no power reaching the router - PSU or outlet issue.
whenToCallPro: If new adapter does not revive it.

faq.a: Most ASUS use 19V; check adapter label.

title: Mesh Node Offline
shortDescription: AiMesh satellite shows disconnected in app.
fullDescription: AiMesh node lost backhaul to the router and cannot serve clients.

fixSteps.title: Reboot node
fixSteps.instruction: Power cycle the offline AiMesh node.

fixSteps.title: Update firmware
fixSteps.instruction: Match firmware versions across all AiMesh members.

faq.a: Yes - ethernet backhaul stabilizes mesh significantly.

title: WPS Failed
shortDescription: WPS pairing attempt failed or timed out.
fullDescription: Solid red WPS LED indicates a failed WPS authentication or timeout window expired.

fixSteps.title: Retry WPS
fixSteps.instruction: Press WPS within 2 minutes on both devices.

videoSearchQuery: ASUS WPS LED Solid Red fix

faq.a: No - disable PIN method, PBC only if needed.

title: LED Disabled
shortDescription: User toggled LEDs off via button or app.
fullDescription: All status LEDs are off but WiFi works - LED display has been disabled in firmware.

fixSteps.title: Press LED button
fixSteps.instruction: Press dedicated LED on/off button on rear.

videoSearchQuery: ASUS LED All Off Working WiFi fix

faq.a: Many users disable LEDs in bedrooms - normal feature.

title: WAN Status Disconnected
fullDescription: Network Map in ASUSWRT shows red Internet status - WAN failed despite link.

fixSteps.title: Check WAN type
fixSteps.instruction: WAN > Internet Connection - verify type matches ISP.

fixSteps.title: Clone MAC
fixSteps.instruction: Use MAC clone if ISP locks to original modem MAC.

whenToCallPro: If ISP confirms account active but no IP.
videoSearchQuery: ASUS Internet Failed in Network Map fix

faq.a: Most ISPs use DHCP/Auto IP; some require PPPoE.

title: Cloud Service Unreachable
shortDescription: AiProtection cannot connect to Trend Micro cloud.
fullDescription: AiProtection features fail with Trend Micro service error - cloud unreachable or license issue.

fixSteps.title: Fix time
fixSteps.instruction: Administration > System > Time set correctly via NTP.

videoSearchQuery: ASUS AiProtection Trend Micro Error fix

faq.a: AiProtection is free but requires functioning Trend Micro link.

title: USB Mount Failure
shortDescription: USB drive plugged but not visible in admin.
fullDescription: ASUS firmware fails to mount USB drive - filesystem or power issue.

fixSteps.title: Format NTFS
fixSteps.instruction: Reformat to NTFS or ext4 on PC.

fixSteps.title: Use USB 3.0 port
fixSteps.instruction: Move drive to blue USB 3.0 port if available.

whenToCallPro: If drive works on PC but not router.
videoSearchQuery: ASUS USB Disk Not Recognized fix

title: Failed Firmware Update
shortDescription: Router restarts continuously after firmware flash.
fullDescription: After firmware update, router cycles through boot indefinitely - flash corrupted or interrupted.

fixSteps.title: Rescue mode
fixSteps.instruction: Hold reset, power on, use ASUS Firmware Restoration tool over LAN.

fixSteps.title: Flash known-good
fixSteps.instruction: Flash a known stable older firmware in rescue mode.

videoSearchQuery: ASUS Reboot Loop After Update fix

faq.a: Yes - rescue flash returns to factory.

title: Single Band Disabled
fullDescription: 2.4 GHz LED is off but 5 GHz works - 2.4 radio disabled in settings or scheduled.

fixSteps.title: Enable 2.4 GHz
fixSteps.instruction: Wireless > General > Enable Radio for 2.4 GHz.

faq.a: If enabled, single SSID hides band states - check Pro tab.

title: AiMesh adopt fail
fullDescription: AiMesh node adoption failed. Common issue on ASUS router. Most resolve with reset, firmware update, or check WAN connection.

fixSteps.title: Update firmware
fixSteps.instruction: Update via app or web UI.

whenToCallPro: If reset/firmware doesn't fix, contact ISP/support.

faq.a: Often yes — power-cycling resolves transient issues.
